batting_lineup.name: Virat Kohli
batting_lineup.key_strength: Powerplay Strike Rate (197.4 in HP Opening)
batting_lineup.bio: ICC T20 World Cup 2024 Final Player of the Match. Demonstrated an unprecedented 197.4 strike rate when opening under immediate tournament leverage, attacking the new ball against high-pace attacks with minimal dot ball percentage.

batting_lineup.name: Quinton de Kock
batting_lineup.bio: Calm, explosive wicketkeeper-opener averaging a stellar 48.0 against Tier-1 pace attacks in critical Powerplays. Neutralizes swing bowling while keeping the scoreboard moving at 152.4 SR without giving away early dismissals.

batting_lineup.name: Shreyas Iyer
batting_lineup.bio: IPL championship-winning captain with an astonishing 58.5 average and 198.3 strike rate at Position 3 under pressure. Possesses unmatched 51.4% strike rotation, completely dismantling spin during the critical middle overs.

batting_lineup.name: Rovman Powell
batting_lineup.bio: Rajasthan Royals powerhouse captain. Achieved an unmatched 91.9 clutch rating at slot 4, punishing both mystery spinners and death pacers alike with heavy six-hitting when the Required Run Rate climbs beyond 11.5 RPO.

batting_lineup.name: Namboori Tilak Varma
batting_lineup.key_strength: Gear Shifting from 30/3 Collapse to Death Finish
batting_lineup.bio: Rescues innings from top-order collapses. Accumulated 679 high-pressure runs at slot 5 with a 45.3 average and 168.5 SR. Elevates performance by +30% in playoff and decider fixtures.

batting_lineup.name: Shashank Singh
batting_lineup.key_strength: Ice-Cool Boundary Execution in 12+ RRR Chases
batting_lineup.bio: Dead-eye finisher averaging 45.0 when chasing steep Required Run Rates in the final 5 overs. Demonstrates extraordinary calmness under pressure with a 51.6% strike rotation and clutch boundary conversion.

batting_lineup.name: Naman Dhir
batting_lineup.bio: Highest positional score in the entire tournament dataset (97.2). Smashes at a 197.0 strike rate in high-pressure death overs with an extraordinary 27.5% boundary conversion rate and +51% clutch elevation.

bowling_attack.name: Shaheen Afridi
bowling_attack.bio: Concedes just 6.19 RPO in high-pressure Powerplays with an incredible 55.1% post-boundary comeback rate. Known globally for devastating first-over breakthroughs in ICC knockout matches and deciders.

bowling_attack.name: Harpreet Brar
bowling_attack.bio: Suffocates opposition acceleration through overs 7 to 15, boasting a 6.35 economy and 13.9 wicket strike rate in high-pressure games. Constricts scoring areas and forces rash strokes from top-order batters.

bowling_attack.name: Jasprit Bumrah
bowling_attack.bio: Global benchmark death bowler. Bowled 736 high-pressure deliveries maintaining an elite 6.88 economy with 46.8% post-boundary composure (highest among major pacers). Zero performance drop-off against Tier-1 opposition.

bowling_attack.name: Sunil Narine
bowling_attack.bio: Tournament #1 clutch bowler. Delivers an unbelievable 6.18 economy at the death, yielding virtually zero boundaries (11.1%) and claiming a wicket every 11.2 deliveries under maximum scoreboard pressure.
